HorizontalCard.title: MISSION
text: Our mission is to simplify and secure the foreign trade process between Argentina and China. Through our comprehensive services, we seek to strengthen Argentine SMEs, providing them with the tools and knowledge necessary to successfully carry out all foreign trade procedures in the Chinese market.

With years of experience in the Chinese market, fully understanding the language, culture and particularities of each negotiation, we know how to mitigate risks and guarantee the satisfaction of our clients at every stage of the operation.
We are committed to being strategic partners of our clients, offering solutions tailored to their specific needs and helping them achieve their business objectives effectively and safely.

InvertCard.title: VISION
text: Sino Argentina Group aims to be the definitive commercial bridge between Argentina and China, facilitating the access of Argentine companies to the vast Chinese market and optimizing their commercial operations.

We see ourselves as leaders in commercial management with the Chinese market, being recognized for the mastery of the Chinese language and culture of our professionals located in China, both Argentine and Chinese, providing reliability and commitment in each transaction; and contributing to the strengthening of Argentine SMEs in the Chinese market.
We believe in a future where bilateral trade between Argentina and China develops with transparency, efficiency and mutual trust, marking a positive impact on the economies of both countries.

RoadMap.title: STEP BY STEP IN ANALYSIS, NEGOTIATION AND PURCHASES WITH SUPPLIERS IN CHINA

mapCard.text_1: A meeting is held where the client provides details about the product to be sought (technical specifications, quantity, quality, etc.). Certification and compliance requirements are then defined. Finally, an estimated budget is established.
mapCard.text_2: A thorough search is conducted in specialized databases and e-commerce platforms. Multiple suppliers are contacted and evaluated based on their reputation, production capacity and prices. Detailed product information, samples and catalogues are requested.
mapCard.text_3: If necessary, factory visits are organized to verify production conditions and product quality.
mapCard.text_4: Prices, delivery times, payment terms, warranties and contract terms are negotiated. The contract is drafted and reviewed jointly with the client.
mapCard.text_5: The production process is constantly monitored, ensuring that quality standards and agreed deadlines are met.
mapCard.text_6: An independent inspection company is hired to verify the quality of the products before shipment.
mapCard.text_7: The shipping details are coordinated, including packaging, transport and customs clearance at origin. Then, the international shipment is carried out, with all international logistics being tracked.
